_llm_instructions: Populate the fields of 'QUALITY MANAGEMENT PLAN' and write the value of each field under 'Generated Value', based on the project context. Context: the project carrying reference PMO-04.05.01.

f01_Organizational_Quality_Policy_and_Fr.label: Organizational Quality Policy and Framework
f01_Organizational_Quality_Policy_and_Fr.guidance: The overarching corporate quality principles and methodology (e.g., ISO, Lean Six Sigma, CMMI).

f02_Applicable_Industry_Quality_Standard.label: Applicable Industry Quality Standards
f02_Applicable_Industry_Quality_Standard.guidance: Specific external regulatory, engineering, or legal quality standards enforced.

f03_Project_Quality_Goals_and_Thresholds.label: Project Quality Goals and Thresholds
f03_Project_Quality_Goals_and_Thresholds.guidance: Measurable quality targets regarding defect containment, test coverage, and customer satisfaction.

f04_Continuous_Improvement_Objectives.label: Continuous Improvement Objectives
f04_Continuous_Improvement_Objectives.guidance: Process enhancement goals and lessons learned integration mechanisms.

f05_Quality_Assurance_QA_Process.section: Quality Assurance and Quality Control Procedures
f05_Quality_Assurance_QA_Process.label: Quality Assurance (QA) Process
f05_Quality_Assurance_QA_Process.guidance: Audits and process compliance activities ensuring project execution adheres to approved standards.

f06_Quality_Control_QC_Testing_Protocol.section: Quality Assurance and Quality Control Procedures
f06_Quality_Control_QC_Testing_Protocol.label: Quality Control (QC) Testing Protocol
f06_Quality_Control_QC_Testing_Protocol.guidance: Inspection, automated testing, and peer review workflows used to verify deliverable quality.

f07_Non_Conformance_and_Defect_Managemen.section: Quality Assurance and Quality Control Procedures
f07_Non_Conformance_and_Defect_Managemen.label: Non-Conformance and Defect Management
f07_Non_Conformance_and_Defect_Managemen.guidance: Standard procedure for logging, prioritizing, resolving, and verifying non-conformance issues.

f08_Quality_Roles_and_Responsibilities.label: Quality Roles and Responsibilities
f08_Quality_Roles_and_Responsibilities.guidance: Designated quality assurance leads, test engineers, and peer review inspectors.

f09_Quality_Review_Gates_and_Sign_off_Cr.label: Quality Review Gates and Sign-off Criteria
f09_Quality_Review_Gates_and_Sign_off_Cr.guidance: Mandatory quality milestones and gate reviews required before client acceptance.
